name: Lean Default (stronger models only)
server: Any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server, or a command line
models: Any model strong enough to do a whole job from one look at the page
notes:
Built for strong paid models, such as the Claude, GPT and Gemini Pro models.
Requires a model that can see images, can be forced to call a tool, and can plan a whole job in one call. Weaker models will skip work or plan badly; use Default for them.
Sends short instructions and only the tools each call needs. Most jobs finish in one call.
